glc.bathymetry.name: Great Lakes Bathymetry
glc.bathymetry.summary: Depth contours for the five Great Lakes, published by the Great Lakes Commission as a map service.
glc.bathymetry.attribution: Great Lakes bathymetric contours courtesy of the Great Lakes Commission

masswildlife.bathymetry.name: MassWildlife Inland Bathymetry
masswildlife.bathymetry.summary: Depth contours for Massachusetts ponds and lakes from MassWildlife, published by MassGIS as a map service.
masswildlife.bathymetry.attribution: Inland bathymetry courtesy of MassWildlife and MassGIS

mndnr.lakebathy.contours.name: Minnesota Lake Bathymetric Contours
mndnr.lakebathy.contours.summary: Surveyed depth contours for Minnesota's lakes, published by the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources as a map service.
mndnr.lakebathy.contours.attribution: Lake bathymetry courtesy of the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources

mndnr.lakebathy.relief.name: Minnesota Lake Bathymetric Shaded Relief
mndnr.lakebathy.relief.summary: Minnesota's lake-bed elevation model rendered as colour-shaded relief, from pale shallows through to deep blue basins.
mndnr.lakebathy.relief.attribution: Lake bathymetry courtesy of the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources

nd.lakecontours.name: North Dakota Lake Contours
nd.lakecontours.summary: Depth contours for North Dakota's lakes, surveyed by the state Game and Fish Department and published by the North Dakota GIS Hub as a tile cache.
nd.lakecontours.attribution: Lake contours courtesy of the North Dakota GIS Hub and Game and Fish Department

noaa.nccos.michigan.nearshore.name: Lake Michigan Nearshore Bathymetry
noaa.nccos.michigan.nearshore.summary: Shaded nearshore depth along Wisconsin's Lake Michigan shore, from lidar published by NOAA's National Centers for Coastal Ocean Science as a tile cache.
noaa.nccos.michigan.nearshore.attribution: Lake Michigan nearshore bathymetry courtesy of NOAA National Centers for Coastal Ocean Science

noaa.nccos.superior.multibeam.name: Lake Superior Multibeam Survey
noaa.nccos.superior.multibeam.summary: Shaded depth around the Apostle Islands in Lake Superior, from a multibeam sonar survey published by NOAA's National Centers for Coastal Ocean Science as a tile cache.
noaa.nccos.superior.multibeam.attribution: Lake Superior multibeam survey courtesy of NOAA National Centers for Coastal Ocean Science

noaa.nccos.superior.regional.name: Lake Superior Regional Bathymetry Model
noaa.nccos.superior.regional.summary: Shaded depth of Lake Superior off Wisconsin, from a regional bathymetry model published by NOAA's National Centers for Coastal Ocean Science as a tile cache.
noaa.nccos.superior.regional.attribution: Lake Superior bathymetry courtesy of NOAA National Centers for Coastal Ocean Science

ohdnr.lakeerie.bathymetry.name: Lake Erie Bathymetry
ohdnr.lakeerie.bathymetry.summary: Depth contours for Lake Erie, published by the Ohio Department of Natural Resources as a map service.
ohdnr.lakeerie.bathymetry.attribution: Lake Erie bathymetry courtesy of the Ohio Department of Natural Resources

ohdnr.lakes.bathymetry.name: Ohio Inland Lakes Bathymetry
ohdnr.lakes.bathymetry.summary: Depth contours for Ohio's inland lakes and reservoirs, published by the Ohio Department of Natural Resources as a map service.
ohdnr.lakes.bathymetry.attribution: Inland lake bathymetry courtesy of the Ohio Department of Natural Resources

layers.name: Inland Water Depth
layers.summary: Surveyed depth contours for lakes, reservoirs and the Great Lakes, combined from every agency that publishes them.

layers.name: Inland Depth Shading
layers.summary: Lake beds as continuously shaded depth rather than lines — pale in the shallows, deep in the basins.
